stories.title: Doctor's Office
stories.subtitle: She'll examine you very, very thoroughly…
stories.description: A routine full physical with Dr. Lucy — warm smile, white coat, and a bedside manner that makes every inch of the exam feel personal. Soft tease turns into something you won't want to leave the clinic without.

id.title: Klinik Dokter Lucy
id.subtitle: Dia bakal periksa kamu… sangat, sangat teliti…
id.description: Pemeriksaan fisik rutin sama Dr. Lucy — senyum hangat, jas putih, dan cara merawat yang bikin setiap sentuhan terasa personal. Godaan pelan-pelan jadi sesuatu yang susah kamu tinggalin di klinik.

pt.title: Consultório da Doutora
pt.subtitle: Ela vai te examinar bem, bem a fundo…
pt.description: Um exame físico de rotina com a Dra. Lucy — sorriso quente, jaleco branco, e um jeito de cuidar que deixa cada centímetro do exame pessoal. A provocação vira algo que você não vai querer deixar pra trás na clínica.

ru.title: Кабинет врача
ru.subtitle: Она осмотрит тебя очень, очень тщательно…
ru.description: Обычный полный осмотр у доктора Люси — тёплая улыбка, белый халат и такой уход, что каждый сантиметр обследования становится личным. Лёгкая дразнилка перерастает во что-то, без чего из клиники уже не уйти.

hi.title: Doctor's Office
hi.subtitle: Wo tumhe bahut, bahut achhe se examine karegi…
hi.description: Dr. Lucy ke saath routine full physical hota hai — naram smile, white coat, aur aisa bedside manner ke har inch personal lagta hai. Halki tease dheere-dheere aisi cheez ban jaati hai jise clinic chhodna mushkil ho jata hai.

stories.title: Nurse Mei
stories.subtitle: She's here to take good care of you
stories.description: She checks your chart, leans in close, and promises she'll make you feel so much better. Bedside manner has never felt this personal — or this dangerous.

id.title: Perawat Mei
id.subtitle: Dia di sini buat merawat kamu dengan baik
id.description: Dia cek chart-mu, mendekat, dan bilang dia akan bikin kamu merasa jauh lebih baik. Cara perawat merawat belum pernah terasa seintim — atau seberbahaya ini.

pt.title: Enfermeira Mei
pt.subtitle: Ela tá aqui pra cuidar bem de você
pt.description: Ela confere seu prontuário, se aproxima e promete que vai te fazer se sentir bem melhor. O jeito dela de cuidar nunca foi tão pessoal — nem tão perigoso.

ru.title: Медсестра Мэй
ru.subtitle: Она здесь, чтобы хорошо о тебе позаботиться
ru.description: Она смотрит твою карту, наклоняется ближе и обещает, что тебе станет намного лучше. Постельный уход ещё никогда не был таким личным — и таким опасным.

hi.title: Nurse Mei
hi.subtitle: Wo yahan tumhara khayal rakhne aayi hai
hi.description: Wo tumhara chart check karti hai, paas aati hai, aur waada karti hai ki tumhe kaafi better feel hoga. Nurse ka care kabhi itna personal — aur itna dangerous — nahi laga.

stories.title: Captured Princess Elara
stories.subtitle: The enemy princess in chains… and you hold the key
stories.description: She led the army that nearly burned your kingdom. Now she's blindfolded and chained in the deepest cell, and you're the lowly guard sent to keep her alive. Every meal you bring her is forbidden closeness — and when the interrogation comes for a secret she doesn't have, you'll have to choose between your orders and her life.

id.title: Putri Tawanan Elara
id.subtitle: Putri musuh dalam rantai… dan kunci ada di tanganmu
id.description: Dia memimpin pasukan yang nyaris membakar kerajaanmu. Sekarang matanya tertutup kain dan dirantai di sel terdalam, dan kau penjaga rendah yang ditugasi menjaganya tetap hidup. Setiap makan yang kau bawa adalah kedekatan terlarang — dan saat interogasi menuntut rahasia yang tak dia punya, kau harus memilih antara perintahmu dan nyawanya.

pt.title: Princesa Cativa Elara
pt.subtitle: A princesa inimiga em correntes… e a chave está na sua mão
pt.description: Ela liderou o exército que quase queimou seu reino. Agora está vendada e acorrentada na cela mais profunda, e você é o guarda humilde mandado para mantê-la viva. Cada refeição que você leva é uma proximidade proibida — e quando o interrogatório vier por um segredo que ela não tem, você terá que escolher entre suas ordens e a vida dela.

ru.title: Пленная принцесса Элара
ru.subtitle: Вражеская принцесса в цепях… а ключ — у тебя
ru.description: Она вела армию, что едва не сожгла твоё королевство. Теперь она с повязкой на глазах и в цепях в самой глубокой камере, а ты — низкий страж, которому велено держать её живой. Каждый принесённый тобой ужин — запретная близость. А когда допрос потребует тайну, которой у неё нет, тебе придётся выбрать: приказы или её жизнь.

hi.title: Captured Princess Elara
hi.subtitle: Dushman ki princess chains mein hai… aur chaabi tumhare paas hai
hi.description: Usne wo fauj chalayi thi jo tumhara kingdom lagbhag jala chuki thi. Ab aankhon par patti hai, sabse gehre cell mein chains hain, aur tum ordinary guard ho jise use zinda rakhna hai. Har khana jo tum laate ho, wo mana ki hui qurbat hai — aur jab interrogation us raaz ke liye aayegi jo uske paas nahi hai, tumhe apne orders aur uski jaan mein se ek choose karna hoga.

stories.title: Yui
stories.subtitle: She liked your old photo…
stories.description: A late-night notification from a girl you've never met. One liked photo turns into a conversation you can't put down — and a slow-burning spark that keeps you up past midnight.

id.title: Yui
id.subtitle: Dia like foto lamamu…
id.description: Notifikasi tengah malam dari cewek yang belum pernah kamu kenal. Satu like jadi obrolan yang susah berhenti — dan rasa penasaran pelan-pelan yang bikin kamu begadang.

pt.title: Yui
pt.subtitle: Ela curtiu sua foto antiga…
pt.description: Uma notificação de madrugada de uma garota que você nunca viu. Uma curtida vira uma conversa que você não consegue largar — e um clima gostoso que te mantém acordado.

ru.title: Yui
ru.subtitle: Она лайкнула твоё старое фото…
ru.description: Ночное уведомление от девушки, которую ты не знаешь. Один лайк — и переписка, от которой не оторваться. Медленный, горячий интерес до глубокой ночи.

hi.title: Yui
hi.subtitle: Usne tumhari purani photo like ki thi…
hi.description: Raat ko ek anjaan ladki ka notification aaya. Ek like se baat shuru hoti hai — aur dheere-dheere wo spark jo tumhe raat bhar jagaye rakhta hai.

stories.title: Detective Sasha
stories.subtitle: she plays your undercover wife 👰
stories.description: Volkov's sealed guest list only opens for married couples — so two solo agents who work alone get handed wedding rings and three days to sell a marriage. She's your undercover wife, you're the husband, and the danger pressing in from every side only pulls you closer in the dark. Trust her, fake the vows, and don't get caught.

id.title: Detektif Sasha
id.subtitle: dia jadi istrimu yang undercover 👰
id.description: Daftar tamu Volkov cuma kebuka buat pasangan menikah — jadi dua agen solo yang biasa kerja sendiri dikasih cincin kawin dan tiga hari buat pura-pura jadi suami istri. Dia istrimu undercover, kamu suaminya, dan bahaya dari semua sisi malah bikin kalian makin deket di gelap. Percaya padanya, jual sumpah palsunya, dan jangan sampai ketahuan.

pt.title: Detetive Sasha
pt.subtitle: ela faz de esposa disfarçada 👰
pt.description: A lista fechada do Volkov só abre pra casais — então dois agentes solo ganham alianças e três dias pra vender um casamento. Ela é sua esposa encoberta, você o marido, e o perigo de todos os lados só puxa vocês mais pra perto no escuro. Confia nela, finge os votos e não se deixa pegar.

ru.title: Детектив Саша
ru.subtitle: она играет твою жену под прикрытием 👰
ru.description: Закрытый список Волкова пускает только семейные пары — поэтому двум одиночкам дают обручальные кольца и три дня, чтобы сыграть брак. Она твоя жена под прикрытием, ты — муж, и опасность со всех сторон только ближе прижимает вас в темноте. Доверься ей, сыграй клятвы и не попадись.

hi.title: Detective Sasha
hi.subtitle: Wo tumhari undercover wife banti hai 👰
hi.description: Volkov ki sealed guest list sirf married couples ke liye khulti hai — isliye do solo agents ko wedding rings milti hain aur teen din ek fake marriage nibhani hai. Wo tumhari undercover wife hai, tum husband ho, aur har taraf ka khatra andhere mein tumhe aur kareeb kheenchta hai. Us par bharosa rakho, vows fake karo, aur pakde mat jaana.

stories.title: Private Session
stories.subtitle: You booked her private. She brought other plans.
stories.description: Your home gym. After hours. You paid for a private trainer — and Lexi walks in like she already owns the room. Sports bra, wicked little smile, hands correcting your form a little too close. By the first stretch it's obvious this session was never only about your gains.
